owner: CC (code+proofs); Akien (design: the transducer frame, the three callers, the anytime contract)
intention: The SUMMARIZE verb — the transducer across axis two (cairn/devices/librarian/summarize.py): a dense region of the graph (db, tacit, statistical) rendered into articulated, why-carrying prose (nameable, shareable). One move, three callers: summarize research / find-the-pattern-in-a-clump / de-instance for the exchange. The physics that keeps it honest: A SUMMARY IS A VIEW OVER THE GRAPH, NEVER A DOCUMENT THE GRAPH FORGETS — the citation list is CODE-BUILT from the walked region (the model marks, it never mints); a draft that anchors to nothing is refused loudly with the raw carried whole; and the rendered summary DEPOSITS BACK as a node whose provenance names the exact nodes it rendered, so the summary itself is resolvable structure and a follow-up question is a graph walk. Depth travels with the artifact (region reached vs tree size, the graph fingerprint at render time) — what was reached and what was not, legible to every requester.
why: Akien's parts inventory, 2026-07-27, verbatim: '...oh! summarizing!' — the caught omission that named the verb. The frame is two_axes (held-librarian): the librarian is the TRANSDUCER across the storage axis, and 'summarizing when asked' is the second half of the chatbot face ('learning always and summarizing when asked'). The deposit-back is what makes 'we can also ask deeper questions from [the summary]... And he'll already be ready to answer them immediately' TRUE BY STRUCTURE rather than by re-research: the summary is in the graph the follow-ups walk. Depth-carrying pre-wires his third verb (learn+summarize-by-X-time): 'that last one could limit the depth of results, and the requester would just need to know that' — a by-time result must be legible as a shallower cut, not a different truth.
traces_to: Law 1 — the region rides the render prompt WHOLE, so the cache key moves exactly when the source region does: same question + same region replays the cached render (zero inference) and the deposit-back dedups; re-summarizing an unchanged region writes nothing. The transducer never eats its own output (gather excludes summary-sourced nodes), which is what keeps this idempotence true after the deposit-back lands
Law 3 — depth is measured and returned (region vs tree, fingerprint); the summary node is a hypothesis at birth like everything else; the floor stays visible
Law 5 — the summary and its provenance share an address: the deposited node CARRIES the question, the cited node ids, and the graph fingerprint it rendered
Law 7 — an unanchored draft (no citation markers) and an empty region are refused loudly, raw carried whole; nothing quietly becomes a summary of nothing
Law 8 — a hollow transducer (prose minted without a region, citations the code cannot trace to real nodes, a summary the graph forgot) cannot pass the teeth

WRONG-SHAPE SIGNAL: the summary answering follow-ups by RE-RENDERING instead of by walk — if asking a deeper question re-runs the transducer over the same region, the deposit-back never earned its keep.

A summary's ground can include hypotheses the model minted earlier; the citation discipline makes that legible instead of hidden.
